summary.en: A README a total stranger — engineer or not, native speaker or not — understands in ten seconds. Written in five languages from your actual source files, then machine-checked.
summary.jp: 初めて見た人が、技術者でも母語話者でなくても 10 秒で分かる README。実際のソースから 5 言語で書き、機械でチェックする。

mine: Built a skill that inspects a project's own files (SKILL.md, package.json, scripts, git remote) rather than inventing install commands
Generates a plain-language explanation before jargon, a Mermaid diagram, exactly 3 features, a before/after table, and per-environment install guides
Rewrites each of 5 languages for its own readers rather than word-substituting
Built a Python checker (check_readme.py) to validate anchors, links, section counts, and script purity before shipping

label.en: languages the README ships in — EN, 日本語, 简体中文, Español, 한국어
